title: Brave's browser one-ups Chrome with its new support for email aliases | TechCrunch
summary: As the email alias feature is still new, Brave cautioned that some of the forwarded mail may initially go to your spam folder, but this should improve as Brave builds up its reputation score as a mail provider.
